EXTRACT.summary: Extract a part from a date/timestamp.

overloads.label: EXTRACT(part FROM date)
overloads.documentation: Extracts a named part (year, month, day, epoch, etc.) from a date or timestamp.

returns.documentation: Returns `double` for parts such as `epoch` and `julian`, `date` for `date`, and `integer` for most other parts.

parameters.label: part
parameters.documentation: Date or time part to extract, such as `year`, `month`, `day`, or `epoch`. Must be a constant expression.

parameters.label: date
parameters.documentation: Date, time, or timestamp value to evaluate.

overloads.notes: Canonical SQL-92 form is `EXTRACT(part FROM date)`. Return type depends on `part`: `epoch` and `julian` produce `double`, `date` produces `date`, and most other parts produce `integer`.
